item.title: PJM capacity market woes spur activity in bilateral power deals
item.description: Power project developers are increasingly seeking bilateral contracts with data centers to finance new projects as recent rises in capacity payments fail to incentivize investment.
item.dc:creator: Anna Flávia Rochas
item.content:encoded: Despite soaring demand from data centers and a large volume of power generation under development, PJM's July capacity auction for 2028/29 fell 6.8 GW short of its target as prices hit maximum levels. This was the second consecutive auction to miss the minimum reserve margin. PJM is the U.S.' largest power network spanning Eastern and Central areas and its capacity pricing model for power generation was designed two decades ago, in a time of more predictable load growth and project development. Investors in dispatchable fossil fuel power plants were willing to accept annual auction revenues as sufficient return and in subsequent years PJM adapted the auction model to accommodate rising renewable energy capacity. CHART: PJM RPM reserve margins, clearing prices Note: IRM = Installed Reserve Margin. RTO = Regional Transmission Organization. RPM = Reliability Pricing Model. Source: PJM Once again, the operator is reviewing its market design and incentives, in response to unprecedented demand from large loads and delays to power generation projects due to supply chain and permitting issues. Soaring demand is outpacing new generation and PJM estimates new large loads will increase by 70 GW by 2038. There is no shortage of proposed new power generation, but developers say capacity payment prices and timelines are insufficient and projects are taking longer to develop amid supply chain, permitting, and workforce challenges. Over 50 GW of power projects have grid connection agreements and are ready to be developed while 220 GW are under evaluation in PJM's grid connection queue. To accelerate new power generation, PJM has introduced a one-time Reliability Backstop Procurement (RBP) auction and a parallel process to facilitate bilateral power deals between generators and large loads which could support new power capacity. Some projects are already moving forward, buoyed by cap and floor prices implemented by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) in 2025 in response to spiking PJM auction prices and bilateral contracts. Since then, developers in the region have announced over 43 GW of projects, mostly in data center hubs in Ohio and West Virginia, according to PJM Power Providers Group. Some developers are already "unwinding some of the challenges and seeing where the investment opportunities exist,” said Todd Snitchler, CEO of the Electric Power Supply Association (EPSA). “Capital is flowing even as we're sorting out what's going on with PJM's longer-term market reform effort." Short-term reform PJM's Reliability Backstop Procurement (RBP) auction will offer higher prices and longer contracts than previous auctions. Alongside this, PJM will offer a matchmaking process for new power projects and large loads to secure bilateral deals. Bilateral contracting was highly preferred among members and PJM “supports bilateral activity to bring new load onto the system,” the grid operator said in July. Download our exclusive report on U.S. grid investment trends. The bilateral matchmaking process could support development of new power projects, as capacity market revenue alone is not enough to justify new investments, Ari Pribadi, Global co-head of Investment Banking at Marathon Capital, told Reuters Events. The matchmaking process allows power developers to build on optimum sites away from the data center sites, Pribadi noted. “This is the right policy. Rather than trying to jam a power plant and a data center in a co-located area, this scheme will enable power plants and data centers to be located where each one of them makes sense to be built,” he said. CHART: Forecast power demand growth by US region STEO = EIA's Short-Term Energy Outlook. Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), February 2026. The bilateral matchmaking process opened in June and will continue for six to nine months with the first matches expected to be disclosed to participants in August. The scheme allows parties to tailor contract structure, including tenure and pricing, to their needs. "Certainly, bilateral contracting for new capacity is the preferred way for everyone for this new capacity to enter the market," Glen Thomas, president of the PJM Power Providers Group association and president of regulatory consulting firm GT Power Group. "If the new large loads can step up [and] sign these bilateral contracts to build the new capacity, it will get developed." Higher price caps PJM's RBP auction has a price cap of $555/MW-day for new generation, far higher than the $325/MW-day price cap in the latest capacity auction in July. Pending approval by FERC, the auction is scheduled to start in late September and close in October with results released by December. Loads that sign bilateral contracts will be excluded from the estimated procurement target in the auction. Projects in the bilateral matching process that do not secure agreements may bid into the auction. PJM's July auction procured 138.3 GW for 2028/29, but only 317 MW came from new generation and 208 MW from upgrades that cleared at the maximum price. Join 1,500+ senior decision-makers across energy and finance at Reuters Events Energy LIVE 2026 . Earthrise Energy CEO Jeff Hunter said the company is “comfortable” with the prices offered in PJM's annual capacity auctions for its existing natural gas-fired plants in the region, but said the caps are not sufficient to attract new dispatchable resources at scale. “All of our assets are contracted, so we're not too concerned about it, but as we look forward, if I were going to do a new development somewhere, thermal [natural gas-fired] or solar or batteries, I would probably look for other markets first,” Hunter told Reuters Events. The higher price cap for the RBP should allow capacity procurement of new natural gas and battery projects, assuming they sign a 15-year contract, according to Julia Hoos, head of USA East (PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, SERC) at Aurora Energy Research. “The hope is that projects that are eligible to participate in the RBP are fairly advanced because they need to construct in the next couple of years and they should have a reasonable handle on what their costs will be,” Hoos noted. However, Curt Morgan, CEO of independent power producer Alphagen, expects only plant upgrades and late-stage development projects that acquired equipment at lower cost to clear in the auction. Most new projects will need higher prices than the cap, he said. AlphaGen plans to participate in the RBP with around 400 MW of upgrades to existing assets, Morgan said. AlphaGen seeks to develop another 2.3 GW of uprates and expansions with natural gas units at its existing PJM sites in Maryland, New Jersey and Ohio. The company is pursuing long-term bilateral arrangements with large loads, mainly data centers, to support capital investment. “Using our expansion projects as an example, which are in [Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative] states in PJM, and assuming contract terms through 2042, we are seeing a need for capacity payments in the $1,285 to $1,665/MW-day for new-build projects,” he said.

item.title: Ações da Nvidia devem sofrer oscilação de US$280 bi após resultados
item.description: Operadores de opções estão precificando uma oscilação de US$280 bilhões no valor de mercado da Nvidia após a empresa divulgar resultados de segundo trimestre na tarde desta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Laura Matthews
item.content:encoded: Operadores de opções estão precificando uma oscilação de US$280 bilhões no valor de mercado da Nvidia (NVDA.O) após a empresa divulgar resultados de segundo trimestre na tarde desta quarta-feira. As opções da fabricante de chips estão precificando uma variação de 5,4% em qualquer direção nesta quinta-feira, um dia após a divulgação dos resultados, o que está abaixo da variação implícita de 6,5% ocorrida antes do relatório de resultados de maio. Essa variação implícita se traduz em cerca de US$280 bilhões em valor de mercado — mais do que o valor de mercado individual de cerca de 90% das empresas que compõem o S&P 500. A variação esperada também permanece bem abaixo da média histórica de oscilação de preço da Nvidia, de 7,4% nos últimos 12 trimestres, de acordo com a empresa de análise Option Research & Technology Services (ORATS). “Isso demonstra certa complacência em relação à Nvidia e significa que ela está se tornando mais previsível”, disse Matt Amberson, fundador da ORATS. Essas variações relativamente modestas refletem um padrão observado nos últimos dois anos, em que as oscilações reais das ações após a divulgação dos resultados frequentemente ficaram aquém do que os mercados de opções haviam precificado, disse Chris Murphy, codiretor de estratégia de derivativos da Susquehanna, uma formadora de mercado. “Acho que o início da era da IA, quando a Nvidia surpreendia a todos com resultados muito acima das expectativas e oscilações de 10, 15, 20 por cento, já ficou para trás”, disse Murphy. “Simplesmente não há mais essa expectativa de que eles vão pegar todo mundo de surpresa com resultados muito acima do esperado e que as ações vão realmente disparar.” As ações da Nvidia registraram na segunda-feira uma queda pelo sétimo dia consecutivo de negociação, mas acumulam valorização de 11,7% neste ano. Enquanto isso, o índice S&P 500 (.SPX) está com alta de 11,8% no ano, e o Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) subiu 61%. PRESSÕES DO MERCADO A retração da Nvidia ocorre em um momento de inquietação generalizada no mercado. Preocupações com o aumento dos preços da energia e o crescente endividamento do governo dos Estados Unidos elevaram os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro norte-americano, com os rendimentos de 30 anos atingindo, na semana passada, a maior alta em 19 anos e levando o departamento a anunciar medidas destinadas a aliviar as tensões do mercado. Notícias de que o secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent, poderia recorrer à Conta Geral do governo, que soma quase US$1 trilhão, para ajudar a financiar a recompra de títulos em vez de aumentar a emissão de dívida, fizeram com que a taxa de rendimento de 30 anos caísse ligeiramente na segunda-feira, embora ainda permaneça acima de 5%. Nesse contexto, os investidores estarão atentos às projeções de receita da Nvidia, à demanda por chips, à margem de lucro e se os principais provedores de servciços de computação em nuvem continuarão a aumentar os investimento relacionados à inteligência artificial. Como principal fornecedora de chips de IA, a Nvidia é vista como um indicador para o setor de IA como um todo. A Nvidia firmou recentemente parceria com seis grandes instituições financeiras para montar plataformas de financiamento com mais de US$500 bilhões para infraestrutura de IA. A Nvidia provavelmente tem “uma boa noção da trajetória dos investimentos das empresas de tecnologia em IA. O retorno sobre o investimento dessas empresas é realmente importante”, disse Will Sterling, diretor de investimentos da TritonPoint Wealth. “Isso determinará se eles continuarão ou não a investir. Se isso acontecer, acho que será benéfico do ponto de vista da propensão ao risco em todo o ecossistema.”

item.title: Report: Giants WR Calvin Austin III (ACL) out for season
item.description: Giants wideout Calvin Austin III will miss the upcoming season after tearing his right ACL in practice on Tuesday, ESPN reported Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Giants wideout Calvin Austin III will miss the upcoming season after tearing his right ACL in practice on Tuesday, ESPN reported Wednesday. New York signed the 27-year-old veteran to a one-year, $1.5 million contract in the offseason following three seasons with the Steelers, who drafted him in the fourth round in 2022. Austin was carted off the field at training camp Tuesday after his right knee appeared to buckle during a one-on-one drill against Deonte Banks. He was consoled by his teammates on the field and again by Giants co-owner John Mara, who followed Austin in his own cart and tapped the wideout on the helmet and shoulder pads. Austin collected 31 catches for 372 yards and three touchdowns in 14 games (seven starts) last season. He had 84 receptions for 1,100 yards and eight scores in 48 career regular-season games (16 starts) with the Steelers. The Giants' options to replace Austin at slot receiver include Braxton Berrios or veteran Odell Beckham Jr. New York opens the regular season on Sept. 13 at home against Dallas. --Field Level Media

item.content:encoded: Die Bundesregierung gibt Insidern zufolge ihre Blockadehaltung gegen die Übernahme der Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) durch die italienische Unicredit (CRDI.MI) auf. Bundesfinanzminister Lars Klingbeil wolle nun doch mit Unicredit-Chef Andrea Orcel reden und habe ihn zu einem Treffen am 14. September 2026 nach Berlin eingeladen, erfuhr die Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Mittwoch aus Regierungskreisen. Klingbeil wolle die Position der Bundesregierung darlegen und in einen Austausch treten. "Dies begleitet die Gespräche der beiden Banken, denen es weiterhin obliegt, in direkten Beratungen über den weiteren Weg zu sprechen." Der Unicredit-Chef nahm die Einladung einem Vertrauten zufolge an. Die italienische Bank war nicht unmittelbar für eine Reaktion zu erreichen. Ein Sprecher der Commerzbank und das italienische Wirtschaftsministerium lehnten einen Kommentar ab. Zuletzt hatte die Bundesregierung stets betont, die Banken müssten zunächst miteinander reden. Dies ist mittlerweile geschehen. In Regierungskreisen hieß es, die Rolle der Commerzbank habe für die Finanzierung der deutschen Wirtschaft und des Mittelstands hohe Priorität. "Sie ist als bedeutender Arbeitgeber zudem zentral für den Finanzstandort Frankfurt. Dies gilt es auch in Zukunft sicherzustellen." Die Regierung werde daher weiterhin im Sinne des Mittelstands, des Finanzstandorts Frankfurt und der Beschäftigten handeln. "Dazu stimmt sich die Bundesregierung eng ab. Sie ist zudem in Gesprächen mit der Commerzbank und dem Betriebsrat." Die Mailänder haben mittlerweile [USN:L8N44H156 TEXT:"Zugriff"] auf bis zu 49,65 Prozent der Commerzbank-Anteile. Der Bund, der nach der Rettung in der globalen Finanzkrise aktuell noch gut zwölf Prozent an dem Frankfurter Institut hält, hatte sich lange gegen die Übernahme gestemmt, ebenso wie das Management der Commerzbank. Das Vorgehen von Orcel wurde als feindselig und aggressiv beschrieben. Der Unicredit-Chef hatte seinerseits auf Gespräche mit der Bundesregierung und den Arbeitnehmervertretern gedrängt. BANGEN UM ARBEITSPLÄTZE UND AUSLANDSGESCHÄFT Echte Verhandlungen mit Commerzbank-Chefin Bettina Orlopp gab es bisher nicht. Orcel und Orlopp kamen zwar am Rande einer privaten Veranstaltung zu einem kurzen Austausch zusammen, sprachen aber nur über das weitere Vorgehen nach der Übernahme der Kontrolle durch die Unicredit. Doch auch bei der Commerzbank-Chefin hat sich der Ton geändert. "Ich bin optimistisch, dass wir Schritt für Schritt eine gemeinsame Basis in Bezug auf die Unternehmensführung und auch das Geschäftsmodell finden können", hatte sie bei der Vorlage der Halbjahreszahlen Anfang August gesagt. Orcel sieht bei dem Frankfurter Geldhaus großes Potenzial für Kosteneinsparungen. Die Commerzbank bangt bei einer Übernahme um Arbeitsplätze und um ihr umfangreiches Auslandsnetz, mit dem sie den Mittelstand beim Export begleitet. Orcel will der Commerzbank dagegen das eigene Geschäftsmodell überstülpen, das vor allem auf die europäischen Kernmärkte beschränkt ist. In einigen Jahren könnte eine Fusion mit der Unicredit-Tochter HypoVereinsbank anstehen. Das Münchener Institut, das seit mehr als 20 Jahren zur UniCredit gehört, hatten die Italiener deutlich profitabler gemacht - allerdings auf Kosten seiner Relevanz und Tausender Arbeitsplätze. Die Europäische Zentralbank (EZB), die eine Übernahme genehmigen muss, dürfte trotz einiger Bedenken gegen das Vorgehen der UniCredit wohl Ja zu der Transaktion sagen. In einem Reuters vorliegenden [USN:L8N4490RO TEXT:"vertraulichen Dokument"] kam die EZB zu der vorläufigen Einschätzung, dass es "keinen Grund zur Ablehnung" der Kontrollübernahme der Italiener bei der Commerzbank gebe.

item.title: US imposes sanctions on Palestine Action group
item.description: The United States on Wednesday imposed sanctions on the Palestine Action group, designating it a Specially Designated Global Terrorist, according to a notice posted on a Treasury Department website.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States on Wednesday imposed sanctions on the Palestine Action group, designating it a Specially Designated Global Terrorist, according to a notice posted on a Treasury Department website. The United Kingdom previously banned Palestine Action as a terrorist organization. Palestine Action had increasingly targeted Israel‑linked defense companies in Britain with a particular focus on Israel's largest defense firm Elbit Systems (ESLT.TA) . The United Kingdom's Supreme Court has said it will [USN:L1N43L05B TEXT:"hear an appeal"] against a lower court ruling that Britain's decision to ban campaign group Palestine Action as a terrorist organization was lawful.

item.title: Wall Street opera plano antes de resultados de Nvidia; elevada inflación aviva apuestas sobre tasas
item.description: Los principales índices de Wall Street operaban con escasos cambios el miércoles, a la espera de los resultados trimestrales de Nvidia, empresa de referencia en el sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que una inflación superior a lo esperado reforzaba las apuestas por una subida de las tasas de interés en septiembre.
item.dc:creator: Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Los principales índices de Wall Street operaban con escasos cambios el miércoles, a la espera de los resultados trimestrales de Nvidia, empresa de referencia en el sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que una inflación superior a lo esperado reforzaba las apuestas por una subida de las tasas de interés en septiembre. * A las 1353 GMT, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cedía 21,54 puntos, o un 0,04%, a 53.555,86 unidades; el índice S&P 500 (.SPX) ganaba 2,24 puntos, o un 0,03%, a 7.679,52 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) perdía 13,85 puntos, o un 0,06%, a 26.137,16 unidades. * Un informe del Departamento de Comercio reveló que la inflación anual de Estados Unidos aumentó un 3,7% en los 12 meses hasta julio, algo por encima del 3,6% previsto por los analistas, mientras que la economía creció un 1,5% en el segundo trimestre, según una estimación revisada. * Los argumentos a favor de un alza de tasas de la Reserva Federal se reforzaban tras los datos. Los futuros sobre los fondos federales apuntaban a una probabilidad cercana al 44% de que haya un aumento de los tipos en septiembre, frente al 36% previo a la publicación del informe. * "Es evidente que seguimos en un periodo en el que la inflación se mantiene persistente y está ejerciendo temporalmente una presión al alza sobre las tasas, un factor importante para mantener este mercado alcista de la bolsa", afirmó Jeff Buchbinder, estratega jefe de renta variable de LPL Financial. * En el S&P 500, los sectores de tecnología de la información (.SPLRCT) y el industrial (.SPLRCI) eran los que más contribuían al alza, con subidas del 0,3% y del 1%, respectivamente. * Microsoft (MSFT.O) y Apple (AAPL.O) lideraron los avances entre las firmas de megacapitalización, con una mejora del 0,5% cada una. * El gigante de los chips de IA, Nvidia (NVDA.O) , restaba un 0,4% a la espera de su informe trimestral, que se sigue con gran atención. Cualquier resultado que no sea espectacular podría reavivar las dudas sobre la sostenibilidad del auge de la IA y marcar la pauta para las acciones tecnológicas durante el resto de la semana.

item.title: Sodexo plans to cut more than 1,000 jobs in France
item.description: French food caterer Sodexo said on Wednesday it planned to cut more than 1,000 jobs in France as part of an overhaul meant to accelerate growth and improve competitiveness.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French food caterer Sodexo (EXHO.PA) said on Wednesday it planned to cut more than 1,000 jobs in France as part of an overhaul meant to accelerate growth and improve competitiveness. The company said it would eliminate 963 positions, equal to 4% of its French workforce, while a separate project tied to the group head office could result in a further 134 job losses.

item.title: US says Chinese hackers broke into Justice Department, NASA, Federal Reserve, Senate, and more
item.description: The United States said Wednesday that it had disrupted a Chinese hacking operation responsible for break-ins at the U.S. Justice Department, NASA, the Federal Reserve, the U.S. Senate, and other sensitive government agencies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States said Wednesday that it had disrupted a Chinese hacking operation responsible for break-ins at the U.S. Justice Department, NASA, the Federal Reserve, the U.S. Senate, and other sensitive government agencies. In a statement , the Justice Department said that it had seized domains used by two hacking platforms, dubbed “QScan” and “QTRouter,” which it said had been used as part the campaign. The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately return a message seeking comment. Beijing routinely denies responsibility for hacking activity.

item.title: Report: Bucs rookie LB Rueben Bain Jr. has AC sprain
item.description: Buccaneers rookie linebacker Rueben Bain Jr. is dealing with a shoulder injury but is expected to play in Week 1, ESPN reported Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Buccaneers rookie linebacker Rueben Bain Jr. is dealing with a shoulder injury but is expected to play in Week 1, ESPN reported Wednesday. The first-round draft pick (15th overall) out of Miami sustained an AC sprain during Tampa Bay's joint practice with the Jaguars on Tuesday, per the report. The Bucs finish their preseason slate at Jacksonville on Friday and open the regular season at Cincinnati on Sept. 13. Bain was named the ACC Defensive Player of the Year in 2025 after racking up 9.5 sacks and helping the Hurricanes reach the national championship game. Bain, 21, is projected to start at linebacker alongside Alex Anzalone and Christian Rozeboom. He notched 20.5 sacks, 33.5 tackles for loss, 121 tackles, four forced fumbles and one interception in 38 games at Miami. --Field Level Media

item.title: Katastrophe im Himalaja - Dutzende Tote nach gewaltigem Erdrutsch
item.description: Ein gewaltiger Erdrutsch aus Schlamm und Geröll hat am Mittwoch an der Grenze zwischen Nepal und der chinesischen Region Tibet eine verheerende Flutkatastrophe ausgelöst. Nach Angaben der Behörden kamen auf der nepalesischen Seite mindestens 95 Menschen ums Leben, zudem werden Hunderte Touristen vermisst. Videos zeigten, wie Dutzende Menschen an der Grenze von den Wassermassen fortgerissen wurden. Häuser, Straßen und Wasserkraftwerke wurden in Nepal weggeschwemmt. Auch auf der chinesischen Seite im Bezirk Gyirong befürchten die Behörden nach einem Geröllabgang an einem Grenzübergang zahlreiche Opfer.
item.dc:creator: Gopal Sharma, Liz Lee, Navesh Chitrakar
item.content:encoded: Ein gewaltiger Erdrutsch aus Schlamm und Geröll hat am Mittwoch an der Grenze zwischen Nepal und der chinesischen Region Tibet eine verheerende Flutkatastrophe ausgelöst. Nach Angaben der Behörden kamen auf der nepalesischen Seite mindestens 95 Menschen ums Leben, zudem werden Hunderte Touristen vermisst. Videos zeigten, wie Dutzende Menschen an der Grenze von den Wassermassen fortgerissen wurden. Häuser, Straßen und Wasserkraftwerke wurden in Nepal weggeschwemmt. Auch auf der chinesischen Seite im Bezirk Gyirong befürchten die Behörden nach einem Geröllabgang an einem Grenzübergang zahlreiche Opfer. "Das gesamte Ausmaß der Sturzflut ist aktuell schwer abzuschätzen und die Lage in Nepal weiterhin unübersichtlich", hieß es aus dem Auswärtigen Amt in Berlin. "Es ist leider mit sehr vielen Todesopfern zu rechnen." Zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt lägen aber keine Erkenntnisse über deutsche Staatsangehörige unter den Betroffenen vor. Die Botschaft in Kathmandu sei mit den lokalen Behörden in engem Kontakt. Laut Deutschem Reiseverband ist derzeit in Nepal beispielsweise für Trekking-Touren keine Hauptsaison. Nach Angaben des nepalesischen Tourismusministeriums werden seit dem Erdrutsch 341 Ausländer vermisst. Da die Schlamm- und Wassermassen aus einer Höhe von fast 2000 Metern herabstürzten, wurde im angrenzenden Norden Indiens Hochwasseralarm ausgelöst. In den Bundesstaaten Uttar Pradesh und Bihar strömen mehrere Flüsse aus den Bergen in die Ebene. Die Behörden in Bihar evakuierten nach eigenen Angaben etwa 5000 Menschen aus sechs Bezirken. Insgesamt sollen 10.000 bis 12.000 Menschen in Sicherheit gebracht werden. "VOLLSTÄNDIG WEGGESCHWEMMT" Unter den Vermissten in der Region befinden sich der nepalesischen Tourismusbehörde zufolge 105 Inder, 93 Nepalesen, drei US-Bürger und zwölf Briten. Zudem teilte Südkorea mit, dass acht seiner Staatsbürger vermisst würden, die an einem Wasserkraftwerk arbeiteten. Rettungskräfte bargen bislang 55 Leichen. Weitere 65 Verletzte werden in Krankenhäusern der Region sowie in der Hauptstadt Kathmandu behandelt. "Überall, wo wir hinschauen, herrscht Verwüstung", sagte der nepalesische Sanitäter Tula Bahadur BK der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. "Die Siedlungen direkt am Fluss wurden vollständig weggeschwemmt. Fünf meiner Verwandten werden vermisst." Als Ursache für das Unglück wird ein Erdbeben vermutet. Nepals Außenminister Shisir Khanal erklärte am Mittwoch vor dem Parlament, erste Berichte deuteten darauf hin, dass ein Beben eine Lawine ausgelöst haben könnte. Das Deutsche GeoForschungsZentrum (GFZ) registrierte etwa sieben Minuten vor dem auf Überwachungskameras festgehaltenen Erdrutsch einen Erdstoß der Stärke 4,4. Satellitenbilder deuten darauf hin, dass eine Lawine aus Schnee und Fels eine Mure im Fluss Lhende ausgelöst habe, teilte die nepalesische Katastrophenschutzbehörde mit. Die Rettungsarbeiten gestalteten sich schwierig. In den nepalesischen Bergorten Syapru Besi und Timure im Distrikt Rasuwa mit rund 50.000 Einwohnern konnten Rettungshubschrauber wegen des Hochwassers zunächst nicht landen. Auf der chinesischen Seite war der Grenzübergang Gyirong schwer betroffen. Die staatliche Nachrichtenagentur Xinhua meldete, der Erdrutsch habe Straßen blockiert sowie Kommunikations- und Stromleitungen in der Region Shigatse unterbrochen. "DER SCHLAMM IST SEHR ZÄH" Chinas Präsident Xi Jinping forderte einen umfassenden Rettungseinsatz. Die Behörden entsandten 601 Einsatzkräfte, 113 Fahrzeuge sowie Suchhunde. Ein Retter berichtete im staatlichen Fernsehen CCTV, Drohnenaufnahmen zeigten, dass alle Straßen zum Grenzübergang "vollständig zerstört" sind. "Die Lage nach dem Erdrutsch ist in der Tat sehr ernst", sagte er. "Der Schlamm ist sehr zäh, und das Wetter bereitet uns große Sorgen – es regnet ununterbrochen, so dass der Wasserstand jederzeit steigen kann." Der betroffene Fluss Bhote Koshi entspringt in Tibet, fließt durch Nepal und tritt schließlich in Indien als Gandak in die Ebene aus. Im vergangenen Jahr waren durch eine Flut am Bhote Koshi, die durch den Bruch eines Gletschersees in Tibet verursacht worden war, neun Menschen ums Leben gekommen, 24 weitere Personen gelten seither als vermisst.

item.title: Royals pursue 10th straight victory in rematch with Blue Jays
item.description: The Toronto Blue Jays are supposed to be in an easier part of their schedule against below .500 teams, but it has not started that way.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Toronto Blue Jays are supposed to be in an easier part of their schedule against below .500 teams, but it has not started that way. Sometimes it is not who you play, but when you play them. The Blue Jays opened their stretch against teams with losing records Tuesday night with a 5-3 defeat to the Kansas City Royals, who have won nine games in a row for the first time since 2017. The middle contest of the three-game series between the Royals and Blue Jays will be Wednesday night in Toronto. "They've strung together a nice stretch of games here, and I'm glad they are getting rewarded for it," Royals manager Matt Quatraro said. Kansas City had 10 hits and walked nine times on Tuesday. "It's incredible," said catcher Carter Jensen, who had a single, a walk and a sacrifice fly. "One through nine, everybody is putting up amazing at-bats. No one is taking any pitches off, and no one is giving away any at-bats." The Royals, however, did strand 14 runners. By losing the opener of a six-game homestand, the Blue Jays have dropped three of their past four games and cannot continue that trend if they want to stay in the American League wild-card race. The Blue Jays did not help themselves on Tuesday: First baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr.'s throwing error on a bunt helped the Royals to a two-run sixth. When Toronto rallied in the ninth, Nathan Lukes was out at second to end the game as he tried to stretch his two-run single to left-center field. Guerrero would have been the next batter. "I think there you just want to be careful and get the tying run up there, with the middle of the order coming," Blue Jays manager John Schneider said. "If it's going to be that close. I think just put the brakes on." Said Quatraro: "I don't know if I've seen a game end that way on a relay and ball in the gap like that. But I'm glad it did end that way." The Royals will start right-hander Randy Dobnak (2-1, 1.58 ERA) on Wednesday. He has never faced Toronto in his career. Right-hander Spencer Miles (5-2, 3.02 ERA) is expected to be the opener for the Blue Jays in what will be a bullpen game. He has never faced the Royals. Toronto put starting right-handed pitcher Shane Bieber on the 15-day injured list Tuesday because of inflammation of the teres major muscle in his throwing shoulder. "He felt a little bit of discomfort in his bullpen Sunday in New York (vs. the Yankees), so he had an MRI that night when we got back," Schneider said. "It's a moderate to mild teres major injury, which sucks for him and sucks for us. He'll be down from throwing for a couple of weeks and we'll go from there. ... This is tough timing, for sure, with where we are and how Shane was throwing, too. We've dealt with it before this year, and we'll continue to do it." Right-hander Chad Dallas was recalled by Toronto from Triple-A Buffalo. Meanwhile, Royals second baseman Michael Massey left Tuesday's game in the fifth after making a superb play to throw out Lukes at first. Massey lost his balance and fell backward on the play, hitting his head. "That's why we took him out," Quatraro said of the circumstances. "He's doing well now. We're just going to have to monitor him overnight and see that he is all right. ... It was just a little bit of neck soreness right away. But it's resolved." Massey was 0-for-2 with a walk. He was replaced by Tyler Tolbert, who was 1-for-2 with a stolen base. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mercado argentino ajusta liquidez, Gobierno busca impulsar la economía
item.description: El mercado financiero de Argentina se reacomodaba el miércoles a niveles ajustados de liquidez, previo a la última licitación mensual de deuda del Tesoro y de cara al cierre de carteras de agosto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mercado financiero de Argentina se reacomodaba el miércoles a niveles ajustados de liquidez, previo a la última licitación mensual de deuda del Tesoro y de cara al cierre de carteras de agosto. La moneda nacional, el peso, renovaba su piso histórico intradiario, mientras que los activos tendían a mejorar ante un controlado riesgo país, aunque aún por arriba de los 500 puntos básicos. Ante una economía doméstica que no alcanza a despegar con fortaleza, el Gobierno anunció un esquema para promover los créditos hipotecarios para fomentar una mayor dinámica. El ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo, dijo en ronda de prensa que el oficial 'Fondo de Garantía Sustentable' (FGS) del ente previsional ANSES licitará depósitos a plazo fijo atados a la inflación (UVA) y contra eso los bancos deberán asignar fondos a otorgar préstamos para la vivienda con tasas mínimas para los depósitos y máximas para los créditos. El peso mayorista perdía un 0,2% a récord mínimo de 1.515 por dólar a las 1425 GMT, junto a contratos a futuro con una ligera tendencia de baja. Esta coyuntura hace que el banco central (BCRA) disminuya la sumatoria diaria de dólares adquiridos para respaldar sus reservas internacionales, las que suman casi 51.000 millones de dólares. "La cantidad de dinero continúa siendo la variable de ajuste de la política monetaria, generando volatilidad en las tasas; pese a que la aparición de liquidez sobre el cierre (de la semana pasada) redujo el costo de 'funding' impulsando la renta fija, persiste la cautela del mercado ante eventuales nuevos ajustes monetarios", reportó el banco Patagonia. "En este esquema, el banco central (BCRA) priorizaría la estabilidad cambiaria por sobre la de tasas, dado su rol en el anclaje de expectativas; la inflación mayorista de 0,8% (en julio) constituye una señal positiva", agregó. El índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires subía un 0,6% y los bonos públicos extrabursátiles permanecían equilibrados en promedio, con un riesgo país en la zona de los 509 unidades. El Tesoro buscará este jueves renovar deuda interna para afrontar obligaciones por unos 12,6 billones de pesos (unos 8.330 millones de dólares), sin que aparezca en carpeta el Bonar 29 ('AO29'). Para esta operatoria se ofrecerán tres papeles a tasa fija ('S30N6', 'S29E7' y 'T31Y7'), una letra Lecer ('X29E7') y otra atada al 'dollar linked' ('D30O6'), todos con amortización durante el mandato libertario de Javier Milei, quien preside Argentina hasta finales del 2027. Gran parte del compromiso a cubrir está dado por títulos atados al tipo de cambio, cuya paridad para el pago será el del peso al cierre de este miércoles en la franja interbancaria. "El Tesoro vuelve a ofrecer un menú de instrumentos de corto plazo, con mayor presencia de alternativas a tasa fija aprovechando la caída en los 'break evens' de inflación. El objetivo es no presionar a la curva pesos, ni esterilizando ni sumando oferta de bonos largos", sostuvo el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex. Acotó que "el atractivo está en la (letra) Lecer de enero (X29E7) aprovechando que el tramo corto 'CER' (inflación) quedó con rendimientos elevados. La ausencia del Bonar 'AO29' no sorprende bajo las condiciones de mercado actuales".

item.title: Wall Street tem pouca movimentação antes de resultado da Nvidia, inflação alimenta apostas em alta de juros
item.description: Os principais índices de Wall Street tinham pouca variação nesta quarta-feira, com os investidores mantendo uma postura cautelosa antes da divulgação dos resultados trimestrais da Nvidia, enquanto a inflação acima do esperado reforçou as apostas em um aumento da taxa de juros em setembro.
item.dc:creator: Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Os principais índices de Wall Street tinham pouca variação nesta quarta-feira, com os investidores mantendo uma postura cautelosa antes da divulgação dos resultados trimestrais da Nvidia, enquanto a inflação acima do esperado reforçou as apostas em um aumento da taxa de juros em setembro. Um relatório do Departamento de Comércio mostrou que a inflação anual dos Estados Unidos ficou em 3,7% nos 12 meses até julho, um pouco acima dos 3,6% esperados por analistas, enquanto a economia cresceu 1,5% no segundo trimestre, segundo uma estimativa revisada. Os argumentos a favor de um aumento da taxa de juros pelo Federal Reserve se fortaleceram ligeiramente após a divulgação dos dados, com os juros futuros indicando cerca de 44% de probabilidade de um aumento da taxa em setembro, ante aproximadamente 36% pouco antes da divulgação dos dados. “Estamos claramente ainda em um período em que a inflação é persistente e está exercendo, temporariamente, pressão de alta sobre a taxa de juros — um fator importante para manter esse mercado altista de ações em andamento”, disse Jeff Buchbinder, estrategista-chefe de ações da LPL Financial. No S&P 500, os setores de tecnologia da informação (.SPLRCT) e industrial (.SPLRCI) eram os que davam mais impulso ao índice, subindo 0,3% e 1%, respectivamente. A Microsoft (MSFT.O) e a Apple (AAPL.O) lideravam os ganhos entre as megacaps, com alta de 0,5% cada uma. A gigante de chips de IA Nvidia (NVDA.O) registrava queda de 0,4% antes da divulgação de seu relatório trimestral. Qualquer resultado que não seja excelente pode reacender dúvidas sobre a sustentabilidade do boom da IA e definir o tom para as ações do setor de tecnologia pelo resto da semana. “Este mercado é um cabo de guerra entre lucros e taxa de juros e, até o momento, os lucros vêm vencendo essa batalha. Enquanto os fundamentos permanecerem sólidos, o mercado vai se manter bem”, disse Buchbinder. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caía 0,04%, para 53.555,86 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) subia 0,03%, para 7.679,52 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) perdia 0,06%, para 26.137,16 pontos. (Reportagem de Purvi Agarwal e Niket Nishant em Bengaluru)

item.title: Resultados de la cosecha de trigo francés confirman alto contenido de proteínas, según datos oficiales
item.description: Los últimos resultados de calidad de la cosecha de trigo blando de este año en Francia confirmaron que el contenido de proteína se sitúa por encima de la media, según los datos publicados el miércoles por la oficina agrícola FranceAgriMer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los últimos resultados de calidad de la cosecha de trigo blando de este año en Francia confirmaron que el contenido de proteína se sitúa por encima de la media, según los datos publicados el miércoles por la oficina agrícola FranceAgriMer. En cuanto al contenido en proteínas, el 89% del trigo blando analizado hasta la fecha contenía un 11% de proteínas o más, lo que supone un descenso respecto al 90% de los resultados iniciales de la semana pasada, pero un aumento respecto a la media del 80% de los últimos cinco años. En cuanto al nivel de proteína del 11,5% aplicado por algunos compradores, el 61% de la cosecha alcanzó ese nivel, lo que supone un aumento respecto al 59% de los primeros resultados y se compara con una media de cinco años del 51%. En cuanto a la densidad aparente, que determina la cantidad de harina que se puede extraer del trigo, el 96% de la nueva cosecha alcanzó o superó el estándar común de mercado de 76 kg por hectolitro, sin cambios respecto a la semana pasada y frente a una media de los últimos cinco años del 61%. En cuanto a los índices de caída de Hagberg, otro indicador de la idoneidad del trigo para la molienda, el 100% de la cosecha presentó valores iguales o superiores al requisito del sector de 250 segundos, cifra que tampoco ha variado respecto a la semana pasada y frente a una media de los últimos cinco años del 85%. Estos resultados parciales se basan en el 72% de las muestras previstas en el estudio realizado por FranceAgriMer junto con el instituto agrícola Arvalis. La oficina publicará resultados actualizados en las próximas semanas. Francia, el mayor proveedor de la Unión Europea, produjo 31,9 millones de toneladas métricas de trigo blando en la cosecha de este verano, un 4% menos que el año pasado, ya que el tiempo caluroso y seco redujo los rendimientos, según estimó el Ministerio de Agricultura a principios de agosto.

item.title: Príncipe Harry e família voltam ao Reino Unido após morarem nos EUA, diz BBC
item.description: O príncipe Harry e sua família voltaram ao Reino Unido na quarta-feira, segundo informou a BBC, dias depois de ter sido revelado que o casal estava se mudando, seis anos após ter deixado as funções reais e se mudado para os Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: O príncipe Harry e sua família voltaram ao Reino Unido na quarta-feira, segundo informou a BBC, dias depois de ter sido revelado que o casal estava se mudando, seis anos após ter deixado as funções reais e se mudado para os Estados Unidos. Na semana passada, Harry e Meghan, o duque e a duquesa de Sussex, surpreenderam até mesmo seus familiares mais próximos quando foi divulgado que eles voltariam da Califórnia para algum lugar nos arredores de Londres por um período descrito como prolongado. Seus filhos, o príncipe Archie, de 7 anos, e a princesa Lilibet, de 5, começarão a frequentar a escola no Reino Unido em setembro. Detalhes precisos sobre onde eles vão morar ou qual escola as crianças frequentarão estão sendo mantidos em sigilo. No entanto, eles não morarão em uma residência real nem exercerão funções oficiais. A BBC informou que eles chegaram ao Reino Unido após voarem da Califórnia em um voo particular na quarta-feira. Não houve comentário imediato do porta-voz de Harry. O casal partiu para os EUA em 2020, renunciando às funções oficiais da realeza para seguir carreiras independentes, mas nunca saiu das manchetes, já que Harry acusou a realeza de negligência, a imprensa sensacionalista de arruinar sua vida e o governo de não fornecer segurança suficiente para que ele pudesse voltar para casa. O rei Charles só ficou sabendo do retorno deles dias antes de a decisão se tornar pública, e o casal continuará como membros da realeza sem funções oficiais, conforme acordado com a falecida rainha Elizabeth. A relação entre Harry e seu pai melhorou nos últimos meses, com a família do duque visitando o Reino Unido no mês passado, permitindo que Charles visse seus netos pela primeira vez desde 2022. Mas Harry ainda mal fala com seu irmão, o herdeiro do trono, o príncipe William, e com outros membros graduados da realeza que também desconfiam de Meghan; assim, permanece a possibilidade de futuros desentendimentos familiares, expostos sob os holofotes da mídia. Harry se casou com Meghan Markle no Castelo de Windsor em 2018, em meio a esperanças de que sua união com a ex-atriz revigorasse a instituição histórica para uma nova geração. Mas não demorou muito para que começassem a surgir fissuras em seu relacionamento com o restante da família real britânica. Dois anos depois, eles anunciaram que se afastariam das funções oficiais e se mudariam para os EUA, afirmando que queriam deixar para trás o escrutínio “tóxico” da imprensa que enfrentavam no Reino Unido. Eles se estabeleceram no rico enclave litorâneo de Montecito, perto de Santa Bárbara, na Califórnia, uma casa que continuarão mantendo. O motivo dessa mudança de opinião não está claro. Alguns comentaristas especulam que seus empreendimentos comerciais têm enfrentado dificuldades, afirmando que seu apelo nos EUA está diminuindo e que o retorno poderia impulsionar sua capacidade de geração de renda. O anúncio do retorno ocorreu um dia antes de uma decisão judicial em Londres determinar que Harry poderia ser obrigado a pagar milhões de dólares à editora do Daily Mail, após uma ação judicial por violação de privacidade ter sido indeferida. Reportagens da mídia afirmam que Meghan está em negociações para retornar à carreira de atriz, embora nem seus representantes nem os envolvidos na série de TV em questão tenham se pronunciado; posteriormente, foi divulgado que a oferta havia sido retirada devido a uma reação negativa. Enquanto isso, Harry sempre deixou claro que quer que seus filhos passem mais tempo no Reino Unido e vejam o avô, especialmente considerando que o monarca de 77 anos ainda está em tratamento contra o câncer. “Vale muito a pena lembrar que isso pode não ser uma jogada terrivelmente cínica ou desesperada, mas sim uma atitude muito humana — ‘Quero estar perto do meu pai’.”, disse um ex-assessor graduado da realeza. (Reportagem de Muvija M)

item.title: Judges will take weeks to rule on Formula One's Monaco GP appeal
item.description: Appeal court judges will take two to three weeks to decide the final results of June's Monaco Grand Prix after a hearing on Tuesday, Formula One's governing body said.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Appeal court judges will take two to three weeks to decide the final results of June's Monaco Grand Prix after a hearing on Tuesday, Formula One's governing body said. The FIA's international court of appeal met behind closed doors in Paris in a case that will determine whether third place stays with Alpine's Pierre Gasly or goes to Red Bull's Isack Hadjar, with knock-on effects for others immediately behind. Gasly finished third on track on June 7 but was demoted to seventh when two five-second penalties for pit-lane speeding were applied post-race, with fellow Frenchman Hadjar promoted to third and spraying the champagne. That [USN:L6N42K0N7 TEXT:"decision was overturned "]after a right to review on June 12, stewards accepting Renault-owned Alpine's evidence that there had been a timekeeping error. Hadjar then handed the trophy back to Gasly before his team and McLaren appealed on June 16. As well as Hadjar dropping down, in a race won by Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton second, McLaren's Oscar Piastri moved down to fifth, with Liam Lawson sixth and Arvid Lindblad seventh for Red Bull-owned Racing Bulls. McLaren team boss Andrea Stella said at the weekend's Dutch Grand Prix that the removal of Gasly's penalties raised significant elements of concern from a position of fairness. PIASTRI PENALTIES Piastri also got penalties for the same speeding offence but he, unlike Gasly, served them during the race -- a situation that could not be overturned and cost the Australian places and points. Mercedes driver George Russell, a title contender, finished out of the points after serving a drive-through penalty for pit-lane speeding. He said that he had pleaded for his penalty to be added post-race to retain a chance of it being overturned. "There's a general interest for Formula One and the sport and the integrity of the sport, and there's a material interest for McLaren in terms of our championship impact," said Stella of McLaren's reasons for appealing. Stewards noted when Gasly's penalties were overturned that the situation was unfair to others. "There is no regulation that gives the stewards the power to 'undo' a served penalty. In any case, it is impossible to imagine how such power could be applied," they said at the time. No details emerged from Tuesday's confidential hearing. Formula One's next race is the Italian Grand Prix in Monza on September 6, followed by the debut of Madrid's new circuit on September 13.

item.title: Tongue says Root's message hit home as England eye series win
item.description: England will look to secure their first test series victory in almost two years and shift the focus back to cricket when they face Pakistan in the second test at Lord's starting on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England will look to secure their first test series victory in almost two years and shift the focus back to cricket when they face Pakistan in the second test at Lord's starting on Thursday. The first-test victory by an innings and 103 runs marked the start of Joe Root's second stint as test captain but he was seething when addressing the media on Tuesday following another embarrassing disciplinary breach. Root said he was "hacked off" after videos on social media appeared to show England fast bowler Brydon Carse in handcuffs being spoken to by police officers on Saturday outside a nightclub in Derby. He was subsequently dropped from the squad for the second test. Fast bowler Josh Tongue said Root's firm talk had resonated with the players. "It was a chat that was needed, a very good chat from Rooty," the 28-year-old Tongue told reporters on Wednesday. "He's been around the England dressing room for plenty of years now, he knows what it takes to be the top professional and I think we've just got to do the best we can moving forward. "I think we've just got to make sure we're as professional as we can be. Obviously things have happened and we need to try and move on from them to show all the youngsters growing up wanting to play for England that it's an amazing place to be," Tongue added. OFF-FIELD ILL-DISCIPLINE England have won three and lost six of their nine tests since last October -- a period marked by ill-discipline off the pitch including white-ball captain Harry Brook fined £30,000 ($41,000) for an altercation with a bouncer in Wellington, and reports of a booze-fuelled mid-series break during the Ashes in Noosa. Former test captain Ben Stokes and Gus Atkinson broke a curfew after the first test win over New Zealand this year and were dropped for the next match. Victory at Lord's would help turn the focus back on cricket and England will be strong favourites as they are likely to field an unchanged team from Headingley. Tongue and Ollie Robinson took eight wickets apiece in the first test as Pakistan's batting crumbled but Root is expecting a sterner test with the touring side hopeful that captain Babar Azam will return from a finger injury. "We know the individual brilliance that lies within that team and what Pakistan are capable of collectively," he said. "We also know that whenever we play anyone at Lord's, they generally raise their game. This (England) group won't be taking anything for granted." ($1 = £0.7352)

item.title: Receita do governo com taxação de dividendos soma R$3,1 bi no ano, muito abaixo do esperado
item.description: A arrecadação do governo federal com Imposto de Renda sobre dividendos totalizou R$3,145 bilhões de janeiro a julho, informou nesta quarta-feira a Receita Federal, somando em sete meses valor correspondente a cerca de 11% do esperado pela equipe econômica para o ano completo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A arrecadação do governo federal com Imposto de Renda sobre dividendos totalizou R$3,145 bilhões de janeiro a julho, informou nesta quarta-feira a Receita Federal, somando em sete meses valor correspondente a cerca de 11% do esperado pela equipe econômica para o ano completo. A projeção oficial do governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para a cobrança de 10% sobre dividendos remetidos para o exterior e sobre proventos acima de R$50 mil distribuídos no país é de uma arrecadação de R$28 bilhões em 2026. Em julho, o fisco já havia apontado o fraco desempenho da arrecadação por essas vias, mas, ainda assim, a equipe econômica optou por [USN:L1N43Q0T1 TEXT:"não incorporar"] essa frustração de receita em sua avaliação fiscal, o que poderia levar a um contingenciamento de verbas de ministérios. Na ocasião, o ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti, afirmou que a decisão respeitava um “conservadorismo” do governo e que uma revisão das projeções oficiais poderia ser eventualmente feita em setembro. Entre janeiro e julho, o governo arrecadou R$2,043 bilhões com a cobrança sobre ganhos acima de R$50 mil, enquanto a taxação de dividendos remetidos para o exterior totalizou R$1,102 bilhão.

item.title: Serena, Venus Williams receive US Open doubles wildcard
item.description: Serena and Venus Williams have received a women's doubles wildcard entry at the U.S. Open, tournament organisers said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Serena and Venus Williams have received a women's doubles wildcard entry at the U.S. Open, tournament organisers said on Wednesday. The sisters have played together in the U.S. Open doubles nine times, most recently in 2022, when Serena made an emotional farewell to the sport. Serena exited the mixed doubles tournament with partner Carlos Alcaraz in the quarter-finals on Tuesday. Serena, a 23-times Grand Slam champion, returned to the court for the first time in nearly four years at the Queen's Club Championships [USN:L4N4251O6 TEXT:"in London in June"]. The 44-year-old showed glimpses of her old form in her two mixed doubles matches [USN:L4N44M167 TEXT:"on Tuesday"], firing down a 120 mph (193.1 kph) ace to gasps from the crowd at Arthur Ashe Stadium. The 46-year-old Venus reached the women's doubles quarter-finals [USN:L4N3UP1L6 TEXT:"last year"] with Canadian partner Leylah Fernandez. The Williams sisters played together this month in Cincinnati, where they lost in their opening match. They were once among the most formidable doubles pairs on the circuit, winning the U.S. Open title in 2009 and 2019. The women's doubles first round begins at Flushing Meadows on September 3.

Im Rahmen der Einigung zahlt der Facebook- und Instagram-Mutterkonzern bis zu 16,68 Milliarden Dollar an die Bundesstaaten, wie aus am Mittwoch veröffentlichten Gerichtsunterlagen hervorgeht. item.content:encoded: Meta (META.O) hat im Streit über die Gefahren sozialer Medien für Kinder und Jugendliche mit zahlreichen US-Bundesstaaten einen milliardenschweren Vergleich geschlossen. Im Rahmen der Einigung zahlt der Facebook- und Instagram-Mutterkonzern bis zu 16,68 Milliarden Dollar an die Bundesstaaten, wie aus am Mittwoch veröffentlichten Gerichtsunterlagen hervorgeht. Zudem verpflichtet sich der US-Konzern von Gründer Mark Zuckerberg zu landesweiten Änderungen für jugendliche Nutzer, darunter tägliche Zeitlimits und nächtliche Zugangssperren. Die Einigung erfolgte während eines bereits laufenden, vielbeachteten Prozesses vor einem Bundesgericht in Kalifornien. Die Hauptverhandlung hatte erst in der vergangenen Woche begonnen. In dem zugrundeliegenden Verfahren vor einem Bundesgericht in Kalifornien hatten 29 Bundesstaaten Meta vorgeworfen, seine sozialen Netzwerke gezielt so gestaltet zu haben, dass sie Minderjährige abhängig machen. Zudem habe der Konzern Verbraucher über die Sicherheit seiner Plattformen getäuscht und unrechtmäßig persönliche Daten von Kindern gesammelt, um damit KI-Modelle zu trainieren. Der Vergleich bewahrt Meta vor weitaus höheren Strafen: Vor dem Prozess hatten die Kläger laut Meta bis zu 1,4 Billionen Dollar gefordert, während die Bundesstaaten selbst eine Summe von rund 200 Milliarden Dollar ins Spiel gebracht hatten. Außerdem hatten sie gefordert, Kindern das Anlegen von Konten zu verbieten. Der im kalifornischen Menlo Park ansässige Konzern wies die Vorwürfe zurück und argumentierte, "Social-Media-Sucht" sei keine anerkannte psychiatrische Erkrankung. Der Einigung waren jedoch empfindliche juristische Niederlagen für Meta vorausgegangen. In einem wegweisenden Verfahren im Bundesstaat New Mexico verurteilte eine Jury das Unternehmen im März zu einer Zahlung von 375 Millionen Dollar wegen der Täuschung von Verbrauchern. Anfang August ordnete ein Richter in dem Fall weitere 567 Millionen Dollar Strafe sowie Maßnahmen zum Jugendschutz an. Ebenfalls im März sprach eine Jury in Los Angeles einer Klägerin sechs Millionen Dollar Schadenersatz zu, weil die Plattformen von Meta und Google (GOOGL.O) ihre Depressionen und Angstzustände verursacht hätten. Die Unternehmen kündigten Berufung gegen diese Urteile an. Neben Meta sehen sich auch die Google-Mutter Alphabet, der Tiktok-Eigentümer Bytedance und Snap (SNAP.N) mit Tausenden weiteren Klagen von Bundesstaaten, Schulbezirken und Privatpersonen konfrontiert. Diese werden unter anderem gebündelt vor einer Bundesrichterin in Oakland verhandelt. In Nashville läuft seit Juli ein weiterer Prozess. Einen ersten Fall eines Schulbezirks in Kentucky hatten die vier Technologiekonzerne bereits gegen eine Zahlung von insgesamt 27 Millionen Dollar beigelegt. Die Meta-Aktie legte im vorbörslichen Handel an der Wall Street um mehr als vier Prozent zu.

item.title: Shelton looks to make an impact at US Open after ‘roller coaster’ season
item.description: Ben Shelton enters the U.S. Open determined to make up for a string of disappointing Grand Slam performances this season, with the successful defence of his Canadian Open crown providing a major confidence boost for the young American.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Fernandes
item.content:encoded: Ben Shelton enters the U.S. Open determined to make up for a string of disappointing Grand Slam performances this season, with the successful defence of his Canadian Open crown providing a major confidence boost for the young American. The world number nine has claimed four titles during a self-described “roller coaster” season marred by poor showings at major tournaments. While Shelton reached the Australian Open quarter-finals, the 23-year-old did not get past the second round at the French Open and crashed out of Wimbledon in the opening round. Still, the American said his triumphant Canadian title defence was a stepping stone. He did not drop a set in the tournament and believes there is still another level of his game to be unlocked. “I thought I was much more clinical, more focused. I was an elite returner at times,” Shelton told reporters in Montreal after his victory over Brandon Nakashima. “But the way that I was able to break serve, the fashion in which I did it, my ability to play defence and offence, I’m excited with the way that I’m progressing. “Throughout this season on the hard courts I felt that each tournament I've got better and better ... So I’m just really looking forward to (seeing) what kind of damage I can do moving forward.” The rising talent also heads to New York with the hopes of a nation on his shoulders. An American man has not lifted the U.S. Open singles trophy since 2003, when Andy Roddick triumphed over Juan Carlos Ferrero, and Shelton has emerged as a top contender. In an August podcast episode released before Jannik Sinner withdrew from this year's tournament, Roddick said Shelton could challenge for the title if the top-ranked Italian and Spain’s Carlos Alcaraz were not at their best. “With question marks around those two, yes, Ben absolutely is a contender at the U.S. Open,” Roddick said on “Served with Andy Roddick”. With disappointing results behind him, Shelton will look to make another big impression at the U.S. Open, where he reached the semi-finals in 2023. “I think that tennis is a sport you get so many opportunities to compete,” Shelton said in Montreal. “The year is so long, which is a blessing and a curse because you always have something new to look forward to, another opportunity to show up. And for me, I know that just one match can kind of change everything.”

item.title: Trump: "Es hora de enseñarle a Canadá que ya no puede seguir haciendo esto"

item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el miércoles que "es hora de enseñarle a Canadá que ya no puede seguir haciendo esto", apenas unos días después de que se rompieran las negociaciones comerciales entre los dos países vecinos. "Tenía un acuerdo, que era un acuerdo bastante bueno, ya sabes, bastante bueno", dijo Trump a Glenn Beck en una entrevista. "No tienen nada que nosotros necesitemos, ok, podemos arreglárnoslas. Quiero decir, hay un par de cosas que nos causarían algunas molestias, pero podemos conseguirlas en otro sitio. Y es hora de enseñarle a Canadá que ya no puede seguir haciendo esto", agregó. Trump impuso el sábado nuevos aranceles del 50% a 20.000 millones de dólares en importaciones canadienses tras el fracaso de las negociaciones entre ambos países. Canadá respondió el martes con gravámenes de represalia sobre unas importaciones anuales de Estados Unidos por valor de unos 20.000 millones de dólares y puso en marcha ayudas para empresas y trabajadores, igualando dólar por dólar los últimos aranceles de Washington.

item.title: Italia chiede a Ue 8 mld euro di fondi Safe per difesa
item.description: Il governo italiano ha chiesto alla Commissione Ue di utilizzare 8 miliardi di euro del fondo Safe per la difesa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il governo italiano ha chiesto alla Commissione Ue di utilizzare 8 miliardi di euro del fondo Safe per la difesa. Lo ha riferito una fonte vicina alla vicenda che conferma, come riportato oggi dalla stampa, la richiesta formale attraverso una lettera alla Commissione, di accesso al fondo. Il "Security Action for Europe" (Safe) è un programma di prestiti congiunti finanziato dal bilancio Ue, volto a potenziare le capacità di difesa dell’Unione e ad aiutare gli Stati membri a raggiungere i nuovi e più ambiziosi obiettivi di spesa fissati dalla Nato. L’Italia ha diritto a un massimo di 14,9 miliardi di euro nell’ambito dello strumento, il cui valore complessivo ammonta a 150 miliardi di euro. Gli scorsi mesi sono stati caratterizzati da divisioni all’interno della coalizione di governo di Giorgia Meloni, al cui interno Matteo Salvini ha ripetutamente espresso riserve sull’utilizzo dello strumento. L’aumento della spesa per la difesa è generalmente impopolare in Italia, come dimostrano i sondaggi, e il governo ha subito pressioni da parte dell’opposizione affinché utilizzasse il proprio limitato margine di manovra fiscale per attenuare l’impatto dell’aumento dei costi energetici innescato dal conflitto tra Stati Uniti e Iran. Il ministro della Difesa Guido Crosetto ha sostenuto invece con forza il ricorso ai fondi Ue, che mirano a consentire a Roma di finanziare la spesa prevista a un tasso d’interesse inferiore a quello che sosterrebbe sul mercato.

item.title: Who are the other men's contenders to look out for at the US Open?
item.description: The following are some of the other contenders for the men's singles title at the U.S. Open, which begins on Sunday:
item.dc:creator: Aadi Nair
item.content:encoded: The following are some of the other contenders for the men's singles title at the U.S. Open, which begins on Sunday: ARTHUR FILS (FRANCE) * World ranking: 11 Frenchman Arthur Fils defeated Frances Tiafoe to secure his [USN:L6N44K09M TEXT:"first ATP Masters 1000 title"] at last week's Cincinnati Open, establishing himself as one of the leading contenders heading into this year's final Grand Slam. The 22-year-old missed much of 2025 with a lower-back stress fracture but since returning to competition in February has reached the quarter-finals of eight tournaments and also won the Barcelona Open in April. "It was a tough year last year," Fils told reporters after his victory in Cincinnati. "When you get injured, you just think about coming back for these moments. It feels very good to have a trophy next to me, especially a Masters 1000. I never won one before. That's why I play. I knew I could make it." TAYLOR FRITZ (UNITED STATES) * World ranking: 10 For several years now, Taylor Fritz has been among the leading hopes to end the U.S. men's Grand Slam singles title drought dating back to Andy Roddick's 2003 triumph in New York. However, the 28-year-old has not had the most consistent season and after ending a run of four defeats in finals stretching back to last year by [USN:L1N4400TE TEXT:"winning the Washington Open"], he suffered an early exit in Montreal and a quarter-final defeat by compatriot Brandon Nakashima in Cincinnati. Fritz's powerful serve remains his greatest weapon and he tops the charts for aces this year with 687. If he is able to produce it under pressure, he could go one further than his run to the 2024 U.S. Open final and clinch a first Grand Slam title. FELIX AUGER-ALIASSIME (CANADA) * World ranking: 4 While Felix Auger-Aliassime has just one title to his name this year, the ATP 250 Montpellier Open, he has largely remained in the top five since April thanks to a string of deep runs in key tournaments, including back-to-back quarter-finals at the French Open and Wimbledon. However, his run-up to the U.S. Open has been far from ideal, with a back injury forcing him to withdraw from his home Canadian Open, before he was beaten by eventual finalist Tiafoe in the round of 16 in Cincinnati. DANIIL MEDVEDEV (RUSSIA) * World ranking: 8 With Jannik Sinner [USN:L6N44I0TZ TEXT:"having withdrawn"] from the U.S. Open due to a right knee injury and Carlos Alcaraz on shaky ground as he [USN:L1N44H0TG TEXT:"returns from an extended injury absence"], the men's singles field at Flushing Meadows looks quite open this year. While Alexander Zverev and Novak Djokovic will be the leading beneficiaries of Sinner's absence and Alcaraz's lack of match fitness, 2021 U.S. Open champion Daniil Medvedev also has the pedigree required for an audacious bid at Grand Slam glory. The Russian has been unconvincing in recent weeks with early exits in Montreal and Cincinnati, but he is a self-proclaimed hardcourt specialist and has already won titles on the surface this year in Brisbane and Dubai. RAFAEL JODAR (SPAIN) * World ranking: 13 Rafael Jodar, a former U.S. Open boys' champion, is at the forefront of the sport's newest generation of talent and the Spanish teenager will be looking to cap his breakthrough season in style in New York. The 19-year-old won his first ATP title at the Grand Prix Hassan II in Morocco in March and has reached at least the quarter-finals in six of the eight tournaments he has played since then, including a semi-final in Montreal and final in Washington.

item.title: Holder Alcaraz ready to reignite season at US Open after injury layoff
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz returns from a nearly five-month injury layoff for his U.S. Open title defence with little match practice but no shortage of expectation as the flamboyant Spaniard bids to win a third title in New York.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Carlos Alcaraz returns from a nearly five-month injury layoff for his U.S. Open title defence with little match practice but no shortage of expectation as the flamboyant Spaniard bids to win a third title in New York. Few modern players have lit up the sport quite like Alcaraz, whose blend of flair and fearless shot-making helped him become the youngest man to complete the [USN:L1N3YX05S TEXT:"career Grand Slam"] when he won his seventh major crown at this year's Australian Open. Alcaraz turned 23 a few months after his Melbourne triumph, but the momentum from that historic achievement was abruptly halted when he pulled out injured midway through the [USN:L6N40Y13X TEXT:"Barcelona Open"] in April and his absence has been keenly felt since. Having missed most of the clay season, the French Open, Wimbledon and North American hardcourt tournaments, Alcaraz returns to a sport that has been waiting for one of its top attractions, noted renowned coach Patrick Mouratoglou. "His return will be great for tennis," Mouratoglou said on social media, acknowledging the unique excitement that Alcaraz generates at tournaments around the world. "It will bring back something that was missing at both Wimbledon and Roland Garros." DOMINANT TRIUMPH LAST YEAR If there is one venue that can ease doubts about Alcaraz's readiness, it may be Flushing Meadows, where he won the title as a teenager in 2022 to become world number one for the first time and returned to the summit after a dominant triumph last year. Alcaraz's 24-3 win-loss record in New York underlines an affinity with the event and offers further reason for optimism and former U.S. Open champion Andy Roddick said the rusty world number three appeared willing to embrace the uncertainty. "We don't know what we're going to get," Roddick said on his podcast 'Served'. "A lot of the time he pulls shots out of nowhere. For him to play this, I have to think the risk of further injury is next to nothing. "It seems like he's happy to accept that 'hey, listen, maybe my legs will be tired. Maybe I haven't played any match reps. I might lose first or second round ... but I'm going to go'. "This is great, it's such a win for tennis." Videos of Alcaraz's training sessions have hinted at a man eager to make up for lost time, even if the true measure of his readiness will come under the lights in New York.

item.title: Inflación de Brasil se modera, precios registran su primer descenso mensual en un año
item.description: La inflación anual de Brasil se moderó más de lo esperado en los 12 meses hasta mediados de agosto, ya que los precios al consumo registraron su primer descenso mensual en un año, lo que refuerza los indicios de que las presiones sobre los precios se están atenuando en la mayor economía de América Latina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La inflación anual de Brasil se moderó más de lo esperado en los 12 meses hasta mediados de agosto, ya que los precios al consumo registraron su primer descenso mensual en un año, lo que refuerza los indicios de que las presiones sobre los precios se están atenuando en la mayor economía de América Latina. El índice de precios al consumo IPCA-15 subió un 4,24% en los 12 meses transcurridos hasta mediados de agosto, según informó el miércoles la agencia de estadísticas IBGE, lo que supone un descenso respecto al 4,52% del mes anterior y se sitúa por debajo de todas las estimaciones de una encuesta de Reuters a economistas, cuya mediana era del 4,34%. En términos mensuales, los precios bajaron un 0,40%, el primer dato negativo desde agosto de 2025. La cifra también se situó por debajo de todas las previsiones de la encuesta de Reuters, que apuntaba a un descenso medio del 0,30%. La inflación interanual se mantiene dentro del rango objetivo del banco central, situado en el 3%, más o menos 1,5 puntos porcentuales. El banco central recortó este mes su tasa de interés de referencia en 25 puntos básicos, hasta el 14%, lo que supone la cuarta bajada consecutiva, y dejó la puerta abierta a nuevas medidas de flexibilización a medida que la inflación se modera y la actividad económica se enfría. La próxima reunión de política monetaria está prevista para el 15 y 16 de septiembre. Según el IBGE, la caída mensual del IPCA-15 se debió principalmente a la caída de los precios de la vivienda, el transporte y los alimentos. Los costos de la vivienda cayeron un 1,41% impulsados por las facturas de electricidad, ya que los consumidores se beneficiaron de un descuento puntual vinculado a los resultados de la central hidroeléctrica de Itaipú. Los precios del transporte bajaron un 1%, reflejando el abaratamiento de las tarifas aéreas y del combustible, mientras que los costos de los alimentos y bebidas, objeto de especial atención, cayeron 0,57%.

item.title: African Union to launch African credit rating agency in October, adviser says
item.description: The African Peer Review Mechanism (APRM) - an African Union-backed initiative - will launch a continent-wide credit ratings agency in October, a senior adviser at the AU said on Wednesday, as it seeks to tackle high borrowing costs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The African Peer Review Mechanism (APRM) - an African Union-backed initiative - will launch a continent-wide credit ratings agency in October, a senior adviser at the AU said on Wednesday, as it seeks to tackle high borrowing costs. Paul Sikazwe, technical adviser on debt to the African Union Commission, said the ratings agency created for Africa will be launched in Mauritius on October 5. "This is a sign of progress in our ambition to provide momentum for the reform of the international financial architecture," said Sikazwe, speaking during a conference on debt and development in the Kenyan capital hosted by campaign group AfroDad. The APRM has been working for years on the launch of an agency that assesses the creditworthiness of African sovereigns as governments seek an alternative to ratings from the dominant global ratings firms such as Fitch, Moody's and S&P Global. African leaders have long said the "big three" western ratings agencies do not fairly assess the risk of lending to African countries. They have also accused them of being quick to downgrade African economies during crises like conflicts and pandemics. The agencies have rejected this, saying their ratings follow the same formula across the world. Debt issues in Africa have risen to the fore in recent years after heavy borrowing, economic mismanagement and external shocks pushed countries including Zambia, Ghana and Ethiopia into sovereign defaults in recent years. The AU is also forging ahead with a push to take common action on debt by its 54-member states, Sikazwe said, including the inauguration of an African Monetary Institute in Abuja in late October, which is designed to serve as a precursor to a regional central bank.

item.title: Djokovic seeks history as US Open endurance test awaits
item.description: Novak Djokovic heads to the U.S. Open chasing a record 25th Grand Slam title, but his latest bid for history carries renewed questions over whether his 39-year-old body can withstand perhaps tennis's most punishing fortnight.
item.dc:creator: Angelica Medina
item.content:encoded: Novak Djokovic heads to the U.S. Open chasing a record 25th Grand Slam title, but his latest bid for history carries renewed questions over whether his 39-year-old body can withstand perhaps tennis's most punishing fortnight. The four-times U.S. Open champion has reached a men's record 10 finals in New York. Another title at Flushing Meadows would take the Serbian beyond Margaret Court's 24 major singles crowns and give him sole possession of the all-time record. He reached the Australian Open final this year after beating Jannik Sinner in a five-set semi-final and also reached the Wimbledon semi-finals, but his Cincinnati Open defeat this month offered a reminder of the physical margin he must manage. Playing his first match since Wimbledon, Djokovic swept through the opening set against Argentina's Thiago Agustin Tirante before the stifling humidity affected him. The Serbian [USN:L1N44C05W TEXT:"dropped to his knees"] during an 18-minute service game in the second set and received treatment before losing 2-6 6-4 6-4. "It's simply a health issue I have. It's been troubling me for the past few years," Djokovic said after the match. "I have a lot of problems, especially when there's high humidity and heat." The episode adds weight to the familiar challenges of the last Grand Slam of the season: late-summer heat, heavy humidity, hard courts and the seven gruelling rounds of hard-fought matches required to win the title. Sinner's withdrawal with a right-knee injury has removed one of his most difficult opponents, yet defending champion Carlos Alcaraz remains the leading potential threat despite arriving after time out with a wrist injury. The 23-year-old Spaniard beat Djokovic in last year's U.S. Open semi-finals and in January's Australian Open final, while French Open champion Alexander Zverev, Americans Ben Shelton and Taylor Fritz and a younger generation increasingly unburdened by Djokovic's aura could make for a dangerous field. Djokovic's greatest asset is his experience. Few players can match his ability to withstand pressure while adapting through a five-set contest. Yet he has less room for error than during his most dominant years. A favourable early draw, efficient service games and short opening-week matches could prove vital if he is to save enough energy for the final rounds, especially as his quest for history may depend on his body keeping pace with his ambition.

item.title: King Charles and Queen Camilla to carry out tour of Caribbean nations
item.description: King Charles and his wife Queen Camilla will carry out a week-long tour of Caribbean nations later this year, visiting Antigua and Barbuda, the Bahamas and Guyana, Buckingham Palace said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: King Charles and his wife Queen Camilla will carry out a week-long tour of Caribbean nations later this year, visiting Antigua and Barbuda, the Bahamas and Guyana, Buckingham Palace said on Wednesday. The main reason for the trip will be for the royals to attend the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) which is being held in Antigua and Barbuda from November 1-4 this year. Charles, who is king of Antigua and Barbuda, is also the head of the Commonwealth, a club of more than 50 countries that evolved from the British Empire. Prior to the CHOGM meeting, Charles will travel to the Bahamas, another nation where he is the monarch, and will also pay a state visit to Guyana.

item.title: Mets try to escape cellar, play spoiler against MLB-best Brewers
item.description: The New York Mets found a way to win another close game Tuesday night, with the Milwaukee Brewers the disappointed opponent.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The New York Mets found a way to win another close game Tuesday night, with the Milwaukee Brewers the disappointed opponent. The Mets will look to continue their late-season surge Wednesday night when they host the Brewers in the middle game of a three-game series. Robert Stock (0-2, 5.40 ERA) will start for the Mets against the Brewers' Dustin May (6-8, 4.57) in a battle of right-handers. Francisco Lindor homered in the fifth inning and scored the winning run in the 10th on Tuesday as the Mets beat the Brewers 3-2. Lindor helped make extra innings possible in the ninth when he robbed David Hamilton of a tie-breaking hit with a diving catch at shortstop to leave the bases loaded. Lindor ended the bottom of the inning by getting picked off first base, making him the automatic runner in the 10th, and he scored the winning run on a throwing error by Hamilton, the third baseman. "The team has picked me up more times than I've picked them up this year," Lindor said. "To be there for the guys, it meant a lot." The Mets, who haven't finished last in the National League East since 2003, have gone 13-8 this month to inch within one game of the fourth-place Washington Nationals. New York also is 5-1 in one-run games in August after going just 10-20 in such contests through July 31. Despite their second straight narrow loss, the Brewers remained a game ahead of the Los Angeles Dodgers in the race for the best record in baseball and the No. 1 seed in postseason. Milwaukee fell to the Atlanta Braves 4-2 on Sunday night when William Contreras' potential walk-off home run was caught at the wall in center field in the ninth. The Brewers, who were off on Monday, are 4-for-26 with runners in scoring position in the past two games. They were hitless in their final eight plate appearances -- all with at least one runner in scoring position -- Tuesday following Christian Yelich's game-tying, pinch-hit RBI double in the ninth. The Brewers are 7-8 in games decided by two runs or less this month. They were 28-21 in games decided by two runs or less through July 31. "We've won a lot of those games, let's be honest," manager Pat Murphy said. "More than our fair share. And when you go through a rut where you lose two close ones like that -- every team goes through it. So we have to be big boys and go through it." Stock didn't factor into the decision in his most recent start last Wednesday, when he gave up one run over 4 1/3 innings in the Mets' 4-2 win over the San Diego Padres. Stock is 0-1 with a 3.60 ERA in two career games (one start) against the Brewers but has not faced them since the 2021 season. For Milwaukee, May took the 7-5 loss to the Seattle Mariners last Wednesday after allowing seven runs over two innings. He is 1-0 with a 3.38 ERA in four games (three starts) against the Mets. He earned the win on June 9, when he tossed six scoreless innings to lead the St. Louis Cardinals to a 7-0 victory at Citi Field.
